offering_description.value: Cerence sells voice assistants and conversational AI software to vehicle manufacturers and their suppliers. It licenses software that runs inside vehicles, operates cloud services that extend its capabilities, and helps customers integrate it into vehicle systems.

primary_products.value: In-vehicle voice assistants; speech recognition and synthesis software; generative AI assistants; in-cabin speech enhancement software

primary_services.value: Cloud-based voice and information services; software customization; vehicle systems integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Automakers, commercial vehicle manufacturers and Tier 1 automotive suppliers

end_markets.value: Passenger vehicles; commercial vehicles; automotive infotainment and connected vehicle systems

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: Embedded software licenses, often priced per vehicle; subscription: Cloud-based voice and information services under term contracts; project or contract: Software customization and integration for vehicle programs
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; subscription; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops embedded and cloud voice software for automakers and automotive suppliers; service provider: Customizes and integrates voice software into customers’ vehicle systems

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia, including China, Japan and South Korea

specialization.value: related lines: Embedded voice assistants, cloud conversational AI, in-cabin speech enhancement and vehicle integration

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Automaker and Tier 1 supplier accounts for vehicle programs; partners / resellers: Tier 1 suppliers that incorporate Cerence software into infotainment systems sold to automakers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Processing voice recordings and connected vehicle data under privacy rules such as the EU GDPR
